description_en: Updates the attributes of a Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-log-store --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --logstore-name test-logstore --shard-count 2 --ttl 30 --encrypt-conf example-string --auto-split true --enable-tracking false --append-meta false --max-split-shard 64 --telemetry-type None --hot-ttl 60 --biz-mode standard --infrequent-access-ttl 30 --sharding-policy example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLogStore

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record the public IP address and log arrival time. Default value: false.

true: enables the feature. After this feature is enabled, Simple Log Service automatically adds the public IP address of the log source device and the time when the log arrives at the server to the Tag field of the log.
false: disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否记录外网 IP 地址和日志接收时间。默认值为 false。

true：开启记录外网 IP 和日志接收时间功能，开启后日志服务自动把日志来源设备的公网 IP 地址和日志到达服务端的时间添加到日志的 Tag 字段中。
false：不开启记录外网 IP 和日志接收时间功能
parameters.name: append_meta

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic sharding. After this feature is enabled, a shard is automatically split when the write traffic continuously exceeds the limit, which improves write capacity. You must set maxSplitShard (the maximum number of shards after splitting) when you enable automatic sharding
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动分裂 Shard。开启后，当日志写入流量持续超限，会触发 Shard 自动分裂，提升写入能力。开启自动分裂时必须设置 maxSplitShard （最大分裂 Shard 数）
parameters.name: auto_split

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the WebTracking feature. Default value: false. You can use the WebTracking feature to collect and analyze user behavior data in browsers or mini programs, such as page views, purchase records, and time on site.

true: enables WebTracking.
false: disables WebTracking
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启WebTracking功能。默认值为false。当需要收集和分析用户在浏览器或小程序中的行为数据（如页面浏览、购买记录、停留时长等）时，可以使用 WebTracking 功能。

true：开启WebTracking。
false：不开启WebTracking
parameters.name: enable_tracking

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable data encryption. Valid values:

true
false
fields.help_zh:
是否启用数据加密。

true：是
false：否
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en: The encryption algorithm. Valid values: default and sm4. If enable is set to true, you must configure this parameter
fields.help_zh: 加密算法类型，支持 default、m4、sm4_ecb、sm4_cbc、sm4_gcm、aes_ecb、aes_cbc、aes_cfb、aes_ofb、aes_gcm。当enable为true时，此项必选
fields.name: encrypt_type

fields.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role
fields.name: arn

fields.help_en: The ID of the customer master key (CMK) if you use the bring-your-own-key (BYOK) key
fields.name: cmk_key_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the region where the CMK resides
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The data structure of the user-defined encryption configuration
fields.help_zh: 用户加密配置数据结构
fields.name: user_cmk_info

parameters.name: encrypt_conf

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of data in the hot tier of the Logstore. Unit: days. Minimum value: 7. The value cannot exceed the value of ttl. By default, all data within the retention period is stored in the hot tier.

After the data storage time exceeds the configured hot data retention period, the data is moved to the infrequent access (IA) tier. When you enable the IA tier, the hot data retention period must be at least 7 days. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308645.html.

Examples:
Scenario 1 (hot tier only, 30 days): `{"ttl": 30}` or `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 30}`
Scenario 2 (hot tier 7 days, IA tier 23 days): `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 7}`
parameters.help_zh:
数据在Logstore热存储层中的存储时间。单位：天，最小为7，最大不能超过ttl的值，默认保存时间ttl内全是热存储。

当数据的存储时间超过您所配置的热存储层数据保存时间后，数据将转为低频存储（开启低频存储时，要求热存储时间至少为 7 天）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308645.html。

示例：
场景1 （只开启热存储 30天）：`{"ttl": 30}` 或者  `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 30}`
场景2 （开启热存储7天，低频存储 23 天）: `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 7}`
parameters.name: hot_ttl

parameters.help_en:
Infrequent access (IA) tier. No minimum storage time is required. Data must be stored for at least 30 days before being moved to the archive tier.

When the log retention period exceeds the sum of the hot tier retention period and the IA tier retention period, the remaining storage time is converted to archive tier storage.

Examples:
Scenario 1 (hot tier 7 days, IA tier 23 days): `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 7}`
Scenario 2 (hot tier 7 days, IA tier 30 days, archive tier 60 days): `{"ttl": 97, "hot_ttl": 7, "infrequentAccessTTL": 30}`
Scenario 3 (hot tier 60 days, IA tier 0 days, archive tier 60 days): `{"ttl": 120, "hot_ttl": 60, "infrequentAccessTTL": 0}`
parameters.help_zh:
低频存储。没有最少存储时间要求，至少保存30天转归档存储。

当日志存储时间大于热存储时间与低频存储时间之和时，剩余的存储时间将转化为归档存储。

示例：
场景 1 （开启热存 7 天，低频存储 23 天）：`{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 7}`
场景 2  （开启热存 7天，低频存储 30 天，归档 60 天）: `{"ttl": 97, "hot_ttl": 7, "infrequentAccessTTL": 30}`
场景 3 （开启热存 60 天，低频存储 0 天，归档 60 天）: `{"ttl": 120, "hot_ttl": 60, "infrequentAccessTTL": 0}`
parameters.name: infrequent_access_ttl

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of shards for automatic sharding. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 256.

This parameter is required when autoSplit is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动分裂时最大的Shard个数，最小值是1，最大值是256。

当autoSplit为true时必须指定
parameters.name: max_split_shard

parameters.help_en:
Simple Log Service provides two types of Logstores: Standard and Query.

standard: supports one-stop data analytics capabilities of Simple Log Service. This type is suitable for scenarios such as real-time monitoring, interactive analysis, and building complete observability systems.
query: supports high-performance queries. The index traffic fee is approximately half that of the Standard type. However, SQL analysis is not supported. This type is suitable for scenarios with large data volumes, long storage periods (weeks or months), and no log analysis requirements
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务提供标准型（Standard）和查询型（Query）两种类型的Logstore。

standard：支持日志服务一站式数据分析功能，适用于实时监控、交互式分析以及构建完整的可观测性系统等场景。
query：支持高性能查询，索引流量费用约为Standard的一半，但不支持SQL分析，适用于数据量大、存储周期长（周、月级别以上）、无日志分析的场景
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The number of shards.

This operation does not support updating the number of shards. You can modify the number of shards only by calling the SplitShard or MergeShards operation
parameters.help_zh:
Shard分区个数。

该接口不支持更新分区个数。只能通过SplitShard或MergeShards接口修改分区个数
parameters.name: shard_count

fields.help_zh: 是否开启，默认 true，传 false 时会关闭 shardingPolicy 功能
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_zh: ShardGroup 分组个数，必须为 2 的幂次，小于 shard 个数，通常为 4-32 个
fields.name: group_count

fields.help_zh: 用于计算哈希的键，大小写敏感，顺序敏感，键不能重复
fields.name: keys

fields.help_zh: ShardGroup 配置，整个 LogStore 的哈希区间将被均为切分成多个大小相同的 ShardGroup。写入的数据计算一级哈希后选择相应的 ShardGroup 写入
fields.name: shard_group

fields.help_zh: 用于计算哈希的键，大小写敏感，顺序敏感，键不能重复
fields.name: keys

fields.help_zh: 表示哈希重试个数，当写入失败时，会切换哈希值进行写入重试。可选值为 1、2、4。1 表示不带重试，2 表示最多一次重试，4 表示最多 3次重试
fields.name: max_hash_count

fields.help_zh: ShardHash 配置，二级哈希。此配置用于在 ShardGroup 内部选择 shard 进行写入
fields.name: shard_hash

parameters.help_en: The hash-based write configuration. When data is written, logs are routed to shards based on the configured hash policy. Before configuring this parameter, ensure that the hash ranges of shards are evenly distributed. This configuration may affect write capacity. Proceed with caution
parameters.help_zh: 哈希写入配置。写入数据时，日志会根据配置的哈希策略选择存储的 Shard。配置前需要确保 Shard 的哈希范围均匀，可能会影响写入能力，请谨慎配置
parameters.name: sharding_policy

parameters.help_en:
The type of observable data. The default value is log data. Valid values:

None: log data. This is the default value.
Metrics: time series data
parameters.help_zh:
可观测数据类型。默认为日志数据，可选取值包括：

None：日志数据。默认为日志数据。
Metrics：时序数据
parameters.name: telemetry_type

parameters.help_en: The data retention period. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 3650. A value of 3650 indicates permanent retention
parameters.help_zh: 数据的保存时间，单位为天。取值范围为1~3650。如果配置为3650，表示永久保存
parameters.name: ttl
